about_the_game:
MEET ROSE!

Meet Rose — a bold and cheeky beauty who looks like a runaway princess from a grown-up fairytale. Pink hair, a plush unicorn clutched in her arms and a skin-tight harness — she's clearly no stranger to kink and won't hesitate to surprise you again and again!

When it comes to sex, Rose is a full-on fetish queen. Ribbons, masks, collars, vacuum toys, gags, stockings, crops, belts, hickeys — that's her love language. One moment soft as a plush toy, the next commanding like a true dominatrix, Rose knows how to switch it up — and she lives for playful experimentation.

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

By purchasing this DLC, you'll unlock Rose in her alt-girl look. You can switch mascots anytime by opening your profile in-game and heading to the "Mascot" tab.

Additionally, you'll receive 5000 credits and 150 super serum.

Most importantly, you'll have our eternal gratitude! Thank you for considering purchasing this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
